examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Parametric Equations of a Segment
examples.problem: Find the parametric equations that describe all the points on the line segment $\overline{PQ},$ where $P(1,-5,3)$ and $Q(0, 4, -4).$
examples.worked_solution:
First, we need to find a direction vector that is parallel to the line passing through the given points. We can use the vector $\overrightarrow{PQ}$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =\overset{\to }{PQ} \\  & =\overset{\to }{OQ}-\overset{\to }{OP} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -5 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 9 \\ -7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, the vector equation of the line is

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =p+tv \\ r & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -5 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 9 \\ -7\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -5 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-t \\ 9t \\ -7t\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1-t \\ -5+9t \\ 3-7t\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

where $t \in (-\infty,\infty).$ 

To get the equations for the line segment, we take only $t \in [0,1].$ Notice that substitution of $t=0$ in the above equation gives the coordinates of $P$ and substitution of $t=1$ gives the coordinates of $Q.$

Therefore, the parametric equations of the line segment $\overline{PQ}$ are the following:

feedback.problem: Find the parametric equations of the straight line that passes through $P(5,-10,2)$ and is parallel to $v=⟨-6,-2,1⟩.$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, the vector equation of the line is 

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =p+tv \\ r & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -10 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -10 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-6t \\ -2t \\ t\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5-6t \\ -10-2t \\ 2+t\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

where $t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).$ Therefore, the parametric equations are:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=5-6t \\ y=-10-2t \\ z=2+t\end{aligned}
$$
